close_reason: Fixed in 0d617cd: all five sibling json_merge_patch helpers (chat/calendars/tasks/contacts/sharing-server memory.rs) now dispatch through json_merge_patch_inner with a 32-level MAX_MERGE_PATCH_DEPTH cap. Beyond the cap the recursion silently truncates — outermost levels apply normally, deeper levels are dropped, which matches what would happen if a server-side parse-depth limit kicked in earlier. Test in chat-server confirms a 1000-deep Object-shaped patch returns without stack overflow. Consolidation of the 5 helpers into a shared jmap-server module is left as a follow-up (out of scope for the bug fix).
title: Security: json_merge_patch is unbounded recursion in 5 sibling MemoryBackend impls — adversarial PatchObject crashes worker
